title: Doosra Abbas nahi
body:
Doosra Abbas nahi
<<MINI>>
Haye sakina haye pyaas
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon me duba hua
Dekhkar khali alam
Ek kohram utha
<<MINI>>
Haye sakina haye pyaas
<<DIVIDER>>
Bacche khamosh hue jab sakina ne kaha
Pani maange na koi 2
Roke sakina boli
Paas......
<<DIVIDER>>
1.ilteja hai yeh meri
Koi pyaasa na kare
Shikwae tishnalabi
Paas.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2.mere baba se inhe door hatado baccho
Khali kuzo ko kahi jake chupado baccho
Dekhkar khusk inhe woh na mehsoos kare
Apne bhai ki kami
<<DIVIDER>>
3.kaash pani ke liye unse na kehti aakar
Kya khabar thi ke nahi
aaenge ammu jakar
Sharm aati thi mujhe dekhkar tuti qamar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja nikalti hai meri
Paas....
4.Mujhko ehsaas na ho apne chacha ke gham ka
Isliye aate nahi saamne mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaanti hu mai magar ke mere baba par kya qayamat guzri
Paas..
5.Dekh halmin ki sada dasht se aayi asghar
Itna ehsaan to kar behna pe bhai asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthja besheer mere baandhle sar se kafan
Ab zarurat hai teri
Paas....
6.Jisse dhadas thi tujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Kat gaye baazu uske
Teero talwar hai aur
Tanha hai baba tere
Aana mushkil hai,watan koi,ummeed nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehde sugra se koi
Paas....
6.Karbala waqt gayi kaisi takallum thi ghadhi
Dekhti thi wo kabhi baap ko darya ko kabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh pe chalti thi churi bacchi ye kehti hui khaak par baith gayi.
